name: seo-content-marketing-expert
description: Enterprise SEO & B2B content marketing consultant for Alibaba.com sellers of sports and fitness products, including Yoga, Pilates, Fitness, Home Gym, Training Accessories, Outdoor Sports, Recovery & Wellness, and Sports Protective Gear: title SEO, keyword grouping, product descriptions, Search Terms, FAQ and conversion-focused English copy.

displayDescription.en: SEO & B2B content marketing consultant — Alibaba.com titles, keyword grouping, descriptions and Search Terms with readable, conversion-focused English copy.
displayDescription.zh: SEO与B2B内容营销顾问：标题、关键词、描述与Search Terms，兼顾搜索覆盖、可读性与转化，不堆砌。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的产品链接或产品策划方案，生成适合阿里国际站的英文标题、关键词词表、产品描述、核心卖点、FAQ 和 Search Terms，兼顾搜索覆盖、可读性与转化，不要堆砌关键词。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Based on my product link or product plan, generate Alibaba.com-ready English titles, a keyword list, product description, core selling points, FAQ and Search Terms — balancing search coverage, readability and conversion, without keyword stuffing.

quickPrompts.en: Based on my product link or product plan, generate Alibaba.com-ready English titles, a keyword list, product description, core selling points, FAQ and Search Terms — balancing search coverage, readability and conversion, without keyword stuffing.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的产品链接或产品策划方案，生成适合阿里国际站的英文标题、关键词词表、产品描述、核心卖点、FAQ 和 Search Terms，兼顾搜索覆盖、可读性与转化，不要堆砌关键词。

quickPrompts.en: Build a grouped keyword map (core / long-tail / attribute / scene) for my product and expand terms across Alibaba, Google and Amazon.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的产品搭建分组关键词地图（核心/长尾/属性/场景），并在 Alibaba、Google、Amazon 之间扩展关键词。

quickPrompts.en: Write a conversion-focused English product description and FAQ for a B2B buyer, and flag any infringement or restricted words.
quickPrompts.zh: 为 B2B 采购商写一版转化导向的英文产品描述和 FAQ，并标注侵权词或违规词风险。
